description: This file contains unit tests for the RatingStatistics class in a Java project. It tests methods related to finding books with lowest and highest ratings, calculating average ratings, and handling cases where no such books exist.

classes.name: RatingStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for the RatingStatistics component that verifies its methods for finding least and most liked books and calculating average ratings.

methods.name: RatingStatisticsTest (constructor)
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for BookService and PredefinedShelfService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, resets the database, and creates a new instance of RatingStatistics.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookExists
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the book with the lowest rating.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests the behavior when there is no book with a rating.

methods.name: findHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the book with the highest rating.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests the behavior when there is no book with a rating.

methods.name: findAverageRating
methods.description: Verifies that the average rating is calculated correctly when books exist.

methods.name: notDivideAverageRatingByZero
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to calculate average rating when no books exist returns empty.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Helper method to reset data and create a new RatingStatistics instance.
